summary: Cisco-certified Nexus support matrix: minimum NX-OS 7.0(3)I2(5) for N3k/N9k, 7.3(0)N1(1) for N5k/N6k, 7.3(0)D1(1) for N7k and 8.4(1) for MDS, covering all models in each family (N3k: N30xx, N31xx, N35xx).
questions: What NX-OS version do I need for Ansible on a Nexus 9000?
Is my Nexus 7000 supported by the Ansible nxos collection?
Does Ansible support Cisco MDS switches?

answer_card.title: Nexus platform support matrix
answer_card.answer_md:
| Platform | Minimum NX-OS | Models |
|---|---|---|
| N3k | 7.0(3)I2(5) | N30xx, N31xx, N35xx |
| N9k | 7.0(3)I2(5) | all N9xxx |
| N5k | 7.3(0)N1(1) | all N5xxx |
| N6k | 7.3(0)N1(1) | all N6xxx |
| N7k | 7.3(0)D1(1) | all N7xxx |
| MDS | 8.4(1) (check each module) | all MDS 9xxx |
